name: Double Chooz
summary: Double Chooz measured theta13 through reactor-antineutrino disappearance at Chooz-B. The near/far programme reduced reactor-flux uncertainties and also studied emitted spectra and the residual antineutrino signal when the operating reactors were shut down.
detection_principle: Gadolinium-loaded liquid-scintillator detectors tag inverse beta decay. Prompt positron and delayed neutron-capture signals are reconstructed in nested target, gamma-catcher and veto volumes; reactor-rate modulation and shutdown samples constrain backgrounds.
